blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) vowed to prevent the country from becoming a drug transshipment point after a Filipino was arrested in Laos over a suspected 521-kilogram shabu shipment. In a press briefing on Monday, PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Rae Co confirmed the arrest of a Filipino in connection with the seizure of 521 kilograms of suspected shabu at Luang Prabang International Airport in Laos. “We will intensify our intel monitoring and coordination with our seaports and airports,” Co said. “We are doing all our due diligence in all these things so that we can stop these kinds of activities,” […]...
